# Secologies

> An independent, research-oriented security platform.

## Full-text access for AI agents (pay per request, x402)

GET https://secologies.com/api/content?path=<page path>

- Example: https://secologies.com/api/content?path=/en/note/example-post
- Returns the article as Markdown.
- Payment: x402 protocol, USDC on Solana. The first response is HTTP 402 with the payment requirements.
- Page paths are listed in https://secologies.com/sitemap-index.xml and the RSS feeds.
